steps.title: Configure App Meta and Project Settings
steps.description: Establish app package structure, Gradle build files, and runtime application configuration.

steps.title: Define Backend API and Admin Schema Specifications
steps.description: Create api_schema.json and admin_setting_schema.json defining data models, logic formulas, and admin setting keys.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Declare system permissions (INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE) and register all activities using Material Light theme.

steps.title: Implement Colors, Strings, and Drawable Resources
steps.description: Construct color palettes, custom shape drawables, card borders, and reusable button backgrounds.

steps.title: Implement Backend API and Network Client
steps.description: Develop native BackendApi client handling authentication, OTP password reset, dynamic data CRUD, and HTTP connections.

steps.title: Implement Admin Config Remote Loader and 1-Hour Cache
steps.description: Build AdminConfigManager to fetch live admin settings (UPI ID, QR URL, Merchant Name) and enforce local 1-hour cache.

steps.title: Implement Local Calculation and Transaction Engine
steps.description: Build CalculationHelper for instant offline cashback calculations, deposit range checks, and total balance aggregation.

steps.title: Construct Splash and Gateway Activity
steps.description: Build MainActivity layout and logic checking session tokens to route to HomeActivity or LoginActivity.

steps.title: Construct Authentication Screens
steps.description: Build layouts and controllers for LoginActivity and RegisterActivity with email/password validation and auto-login.

steps.title: Construct OTP Password Reset Workflow
steps.description: Implement ForgotPasswordActivity with step-1 OTP request and step-2 verification and password change.

steps.title: Construct Wallet Dashboard and Transaction UI
steps.description: Implement HomeActivity featuring live merchant info, QR code viewer, dynamic deposit calculator, and transaction history.

steps.title: Building QuickPay Wallet
steps.description: Compile the complete Android application package and verify all native components and layout bindings.
